description: Free, no API key. Returns the current signed credential summary for one UK company: record date, confirmed-through date, valid-until time, status facts, and evidence hash. Pass an optional evidenceHash to learn if a credential you hold is CURRENT, SUPERSEDED, or EXPIRED. Returns the URLs to verify the signature. The credential is a dated public record snapshot. It is not advice. Returns JSON with fields companyNumber, companyName, credentialId, recordDate, confirmedThrough, validUntil, issuedAt, expired, statusFacts, evidenceHash, evidenceHashCheck, credentialUrl, verifyUrl, publicKeyUrl, source. Each answer states its record date and its source.

companyNumber.description: UK Companies House registration number, 8 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

evidenceHash.description: Optional. The 64-character evidence hash of a credential you hold.

name: check_company_seal

found.description: False when no record exists for the company number.
